title: XShell resolved Module Configuration
description: Effective configuration of a resolved XShell module.

configUrl.description: Fully qualified absolute URL of the normalized module configuration document.

params.description: Parameters supplied to the canonical module by root application composition.

requires.description: Names of services that must be registered before the module is initialized.

assets.description: Virtual and physical addressing for module assets.

hash.description: Generated immutable package-generation hash when published.

builtAt.description: Optional UTC time when the immutable module package was originally built by pack; excluded from canonical hashing.

menus.description: Menu contributions exposed by the module.

routes.description: Declarative Area-relative application Path patterns mapped to module-relative Page targets.

dependencies.description: Module dependencies mapped to their canonical identifiers.

files.description: Normalized virtual resource inventory for the module.

path.description: Application-root-relative generation-qualified virtual path for the module assets.

url.description: Fully qualified absolute physical URL of the directory or package containing the module assets.

size.description: Size of the physical file in bytes.

hash.description: Hash of the physical file content.

file.description: File entry in the effective XShell resource inventory.

moduleDefaults.description: Default values used by pages and components of this module.

renderEngine.description: Default render engine used by pages.

stateEngine.description: Default state engine used by pages.

renderEngine.description: Default render engine used by components.

stateEngine.description: Default state engine used by components.

oneOf.description: A module-relative inventory path beginning with /, or a registered runtime menu source name.

additionalProperties.description: Static items, a module-relative inventory path, or a registered runtime source name.

menus.description: Named menu contributions provided by a module.

href.description: Canonical XShell navigation target associated with the menu item.

path.description: Optional public navigation path used as a friendly alias for href.

icon.description: Optional icon associated with the menu item.

embedded.description: In x-menu, hosts the target Page inline instead of rendering a navigation anchor.

default.description: Whether this item is the default navigation target.

tooltip.description: Optional tooltip text for the menu item.

command.description: Optional command associated with the menu item.

open.description: Optional open mode for the menu item, e.g., 'stack', 'dialog', 'dock', 'top'.

class.description: CSS class to apply to the menu item.

childrenSource.description: Resource used to populate child menu items dynamically.

menuItem.description: A navigable menu item with optional children.
